inputs.checklistItemText: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
inputs.question: On the site plan, what is the proximity of each transformer pad to parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes? Are any bollards shown around the transformer pads?
inputs.regionHint: Look at the parking layout and internal drive aisles relative to where transformer pads are located

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a two-part presence and proximity question: (1) identifying transformer pad locations relative to parking/vehicle areas, and (2) checking whether bollards are shown at all. This is progressive verification before any specific clearance measurement—the agent needs to establish which pads are within the 4-foot threshold and whether bollards exist, not measure the exact distance yet.
